visualStyleNotes: Geometry, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A flat quadrilater plate on a board with draggable corner dots, live angle tags, a bracing diagonal option, and a ring of family preset cards. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Quadrilateral plate: warm paper surface (roughness ~0.5). Sides: thin warm-ink strips. Corner dots: small solid warm-ink spheres with tags. Angle arcs: thin curved warm-ink strips with degree tags. Family cards: small warm paper chips floating around the board with ink labels. Diagonal brace: thin amber strip that snaps corner-to-corner. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the quadrilateral family and its flexibility — a plate morphs between square, rectangle, rhombus, parallelogram, and trapezoid; a push test shows flexing, and a diagonal brace stiffens it into two triangles.

GEOMETRY: A flat square plate on a board with four draggable corner dots A, B, C, D. Angle arc tags at each corner stay displayed, and a total tag always reads 360°. Around the plate, floating family cards — Square, Rectangle, Rhombus, Parallelogram, Trapezoid — morph the plate when tapped. A 'brace it' button adds a diagonal amber strip between opposite corners, locking the plate (it becomes two triangles). A push test sways the unbraced plate.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) quadrilateral plate; (3) corner dots + angle tags; (4) family cards + brace diagonal.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, slightly above, frames plate and cards; labels legible. Budget 7-12k triangles. Named nodes: Board, QuadPlate, CornerDots, AngleTags, TotalTag, FamilyCards, DiagonalBrace. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
